7655550112.label: Dean Margaret A. Wallace
7655550112.transcript: This is the office of Dean Margaret A. Wallace. Our records confirm that Dean Wallace spoke with Dr. Victor Lin by telephone on November 27, 2008. The call was genuine. It began at approximately 10:15 PM and concluded at approximately 10:40 PM. Dean Wallace cannot establish Dr. Lin's location before the call.

7655550146.label: St. Agnes Children’s Hospital Billing
7655550146.transcript: Mrs. Whitmore, this is the Patient Accounts office at St. Agnes Children's Hospital. I'm calling about Owen's upcoming procedure. Please arrange for the remaining balance of $84,560.30 to be received by 5:00 PM EST on November 28, 2008, so that we can proceed with Owen's procedure. Your October statement covers an earlier billing period. The current amount is listed on your final November 20, 2008 statement. Please contact our billing office to confirm payment arrangements. Thank you.

7655550179.label: Dr. Victor Lin
7655550179.transcript: Victor Lin speaking. Nathaniel and I worked together for years. When we received the Langford Research Award in two thousand four, I thought the work was something we could stand behind. After two thousand six, he could not reproduce those early results. He leaned harder on the graduate students. Recently, we argued. A serious argument. I told him a result does not become true because you need it to be true. I was angry. Disappointed, too. Compare the old papers with the independent runs. The numbers deserve a closer look.

7655550217.label: West La La University Library
7655550217.transcript: West La La University Library. Digital Archives and Special Collections. Restricted records require a Library Manager Access Code. Codes are not issued over the telephone. Readers should consult the access instructions supplied with their case materials. Once admitted, examine the enclosed symbols carefully. Reference hints are preserved with the archive record. Return to the library access desk when you are ready.

7655550287.label: Whitmore’s Office Voicemail
7655550287.transcript: You have reached Professor Nathaniel Whitmore in the Department of Chemistry. Leave your name and the accession number of the paper you are calling about. Daniel, if this is you, use the revised summary in the department folder. There is no reason to circulate preliminary instrument sheets before I have reviewed them. Sophie, I will discuss your recommendation after the materials manuscript is settled. For other enquiries, contact the department office.
